mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with lamotrigine increases CNS depression and serotonergic activity, with theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS effects; lamotrigine may also have weak serotonergic properties.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, close monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms, and dose adjustment; consider alternative antidepressants with lower serotonergic activity.
